description: This file defines the CandidateDao class, a data access object responsible for database operations related to Candidate and related entities within the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, deleting, and querying candidates, interview records, candidate history, and related vacancy or interview data. The class extends a base DAO and interacts with ORM query builders and repositories.

classes.name: CandidateDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for Candidate and related recruitment entities, providing methods to facilitate CRUD operations and complex queries for candidates, interviews, candidate history, and vacancies within the OrangeHRM recruitment module.

methods.name: getCandidatesList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Candidate entities based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getCandidateListPaginator
methods.description: Constructs and returns a Paginator object for candidate list paging with applied filters.

methods.name: getCandidatesCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of candidates matching given search parameters.

methods.name: getCandidateById
methods.description: Fetches a Candidate entity by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingCandidateIds
methods.description: Returns candidate IDs from a provided list, filtering only those existing in the database.

methods.name: getCandidateVacancyByCandidateId
methods.description: Retrieves the CandidateVacancy entity linked to specified candidate ID.

methods.name: saveCandidate
methods.description: Persists a Candidate entity to the database.

methods.name: saveCandidateVacancy
methods.description: Persists a CandidateVacancy entity.

methods.name: deleteCandidates
methods.description: Deletes candidates by their IDs.

methods.name: deleteCandidateVacancy
methods.description: Deletes CandidateVacancy record for specified candidate ID.

methods.name: saveCandidateHistory
methods.description: Saves a CandidateHistory record.

methods.name: getInterviewCountByCandidateIdAndVacancyId
methods.description: Counts the number of interviews for a candidate and vacancy combo with scheduled interviews.

methods.name: saveCandidateInterview
methods.description: Saves an Interview record.

methods.name: getCandidateIdList
methods.description: Retrieves list of all candidate IDs.

methods.name: getInterviewIdList
methods.description: Retrieves list of all interview IDs.

methods.name: getCandidateIdListForHiringManger
methods.description: Retrieves candidate IDs associated with a particular hiring manager.

methods.name: getInterviewIdListForHiringManager
methods.description: Retrieves interview IDs associated with a particular hiring manager.

methods.name: getInterviewById
methods.description: Fetches an Interview entity by ID.

methods.name: getCandidateListForInterviewer
methods.description: Retrieves candidate IDs assigned to a particular interviewer.

methods.name: getInterviewListForInterviewer
methods.description: Retrieves interview IDs for a particular interviewer.

methods.name: isInterviewer
methods.description: Checks if an employee is registered as an interviewer in scheduled interviews.

methods.name: getCandidateHistoryRecords
methods.description: Fetches candidate history records based on search filters.

methods.name: getCandidateHistoryRecordsCount
methods.description: Counts candidate history records matching search filters.

methods.name: getCandidateHistoryPaginator
methods.description: Constructs a paginator for candidate history records with filters.

methods.name: getCandidateHistoryRecordByCandidateIdAndHistoryId
methods.description: Retrieves a specific candidate history entry by candidate and history IDs.

methods.name: getInterviewByCandidateIdAndInterviewId
methods.description: Fetches a specific interview by candidate and interview IDs.

methods.name: getInterviewIdsByCandidateId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of interview IDs for a candidate.

methods.name: getCandidateHistoryIdList
methods.description: Returns list of all candidate history IDs.

methods.name: getCandidateHistoryIdListForHiringManager
methods.description: Returns candidate history IDs associated with a hiring manager.

methods.name: getCandidateHistoryIdListForInterviewer
methods.description: Returns candidate history IDs associated with an interviewer.

methods.name: getVacancyIdListForInterviewer
methods.description: Retrieves list of vacancy IDs assigned to an interviewer.

methods.name: getCurrentVacancyIdByCandidateId
methods.description: Returns the current vacancy ID linked to a candidate.

methods.name: getCandidateHistoryByCandidateIdAndVacancyId
methods.description: Gets candidate history entries for a specific candidate and vacancy.
